'''January 2002 Phoenix tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Phoenix, AZ on 6 January 2002. [[Chris Shaner]] won it. It is known from Steve Marshall's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3248">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-01-08-a-new-viper-phoenix-az-1-6-02d3248/ a-new-viper-phoenix-az-1-6-02], DeckTech (Steve "BlackViper" Marshall, 8 January 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-01-08-a-new-viper-phoenix-az-1-6-02d3248/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 6 January 2002
* '''Site:''' Phoenix, AZ
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Chris Shaner]]
